Test_Description: PCIe Device Enumeration Test - Validates PCIe link training for DM0/DM1 in RC/EP modes, programs coherency cache control registers, reads Vendor ID, programs memory base addresses, performs BAR register read/write, and validates device enumeration completion via polling.
Test_Steps:
Step 1: Write 0x0 to address 0xE6004100 (initialization)
Step 2: Perform link training (dm0_x4 or dm1_x4 based on config)
Step 3: Program COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for PCIE0 - set bits[14:11]=0xF (AWCACHE_MODE), bits[6:3]=0xF (ARCACHE_MODE)
Step 4: Program COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for PCIE0 - set bits[30:27]=0xF (AWCACHE_VALUE), bits[22:19]=0xF (ARCACHE_VALUE)
Step 5: Repeat Steps 3-4 for PCIE1
Step 6: Wait 20 cycles
Step 7: Re-program COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for both PCIE0 and PCIE1 with all cache fields set to 0xF
Step 8: Poll SII0 register 0xC0 until (data & 0xD1) == 0xD1 (link up)
Step 9: Poll SII1 register 0xC0 until (data & 0xD1) == 0xD1 (link up)
Step 10: Read Vendor ID from PCIe slave0 offset 0x0
Step 11: Write 0x7 to PCIe slave0 offset 0x4 (enable IO/MEM/BusMaster)
Step 12: Program memory base for DM0 and DM1
Step 13: Write control registers 0xE690000C-0xE6900034 with 0x1
Step 14: Disable cache - set ARCACHE_VALUE and AWCACHE_VALUE to 0x0
Step 15: Write 0xFFFFFFFF to PCIe slave BAR registers (0x10-0x24) for sizing
Step 16: Read back BAR registers to determine size
Step 17: Program BAR registers with base addresses
Step 18: Read back and verify BAR programming
Step 19: Poll 0xE6004100 until value == 0x12345678 (test completion)
Step 20: Call finish(0)
Expected_Value: Cache enable: all fields=0xF; Cache disable: VALUE fields=0x0
Pass_Criteria: Link training completes successfully; SII status shows 0xD1; Vendor ID read returns valid value; BAR sizing and programming succeed; Polling 0xE6004100 returns 0x12345678

PCIe DMA Write/Read Test - Validates DMA engine operation across all 4 write and 4 read channels for DM0/DM1. Programs DMA interrupt masks, preloads source data, triggers DMA transfers via doorbell registers, and validates completion via interrupt handling.
Test_Steps:
Step 1: Write 0x0 to address 0xE6004100 (initialization)
Step 2: Perform link training (dm0_x4 or dm1_x4)
Step 3: Poll SII0/SII1 register 0xC0 until link up (data & 0xD1 == 0xD1)
Step 4: Read Vendor ID from PCIe slave offset 0x0
Step 5: Write 0x7 to PCIe slave offset 0x4 (enable IO/MEM/BusMaster)
Step 6: Program BAR registers
Step 7: Program memory base
Step 8: Configure non-secure protection in NIC
Step 9: Poll 0xE6004100 until 0x12345678 (sync)
Step 10: Set DMA transfer length = 0x40
Step 11: Set source address = 0xE6000000
Step 12: Set write/read addresses (DM0: 0xA7000000; DM1: 0xC7000000)
Step 13: Preload source data: 128 words of 0xC0DEBEED, 128 words of 0xF00DDEAF
Step 14: Configure GIC interrupts
Step 15: Write 0x0 to DMA_WRITE_INT_MASK_OFF (unmask all write interrupts)
Step 16: Write 0x0 to DMA_READ_INT_MASK_OFF (unmask all read interrupts)
Step 17: Program DMA write channel 0 and trigger via DMA_WRITE_DOORBELL_OFF = 0x0
Step 18: Wait for interrupt, clear via DMA_WRITE_INT_CLEAR_OFF
Step 19: Repeat for DMA write channels 1-3 (doorbell values 0x1-0x3)
Step 20: Program DMA read channel 0 and trigger via DMA_READ_DOORBELL_OFF = 0x0
Step 21: Wait for interrupt, clear via DMA_READ_INT_CLEAR_OFF
Step 22: Repeat for DMA read channels 1-3
Step 23: Call finish(0)
Pass_Criteria: All DMA write interrupts are unmasked

PCIe Memory Write/Read Test - Validates PCIe memory space read/write operations through slave interfaces. Programs coherency cache control, performs link training, BAR programming, memory base programming, and executes memory write/read transactions to verify data integrity across PCIe memory space.
Test_Steps:
Step 1: Write 0x0 to address 0xE6004100 (initialization)
Step 2: Perform link training (dm0_x4 or dm1_x4)
Step 3: Program COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for PCIE0 - enable cache (ARCACHE/AWCACHE MODE and VALUE = 0xF)
Step 4: Program COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for PCIE1 - enable cache
Step 5: Wait 20 cycles
Step 6: Re-program cache with all fields = 0xF for both PCIE0 and PCIE1
Step 7: Poll SII0 register 0xC0 until link up
Step 8: Poll SII1 register 0xC0 until link up
Step 9: Read Vendor ID from PCIe slave
Step 10: Write 0x7 to command register (enable IO/MEM/BusMaster)
Step 11: Program BAR registers for DM0/DM1
Step 12: Program memory base for DM0/DM1
Step 13: Program BAR for EP mode if applicable
Step 14: Configure non-secure protection in NIC
Step 15: Write 0x11111111 to 0xE6004100 (sync signal)
Step 16: Disable cache - set ARCACHE_VALUE and AWCACHE_VALUE to 0x0
Step 17: Wait and fully disable cache (MODE fields also to 0x0)
Step 18: Wait 30 cycles
Step 19: DM0_RC: Memory write/read at offsets 0x01040000(data=0xA5A5A5A5), 0x01000020(data=0xA6A6A6A6), 0x01004000(data=0xA7A7A7A7)
Step 20: DM1_RC: Memory write/read at offsets 0x01040000(data=0xB5B5B5B5), 0x01000020(data=0xB5B5B6B6), 0x01004000(data=0xB7B7B5B5)
Step 21: DM0_EP: Memory write/read at BAR1 offsets 0x10100,0x20100,0x1B100,0x2B100,0x30100 (data=0x5A5A5A5A)
Step 22: DM1_EP: Same as Step 21 via slave1
Step 23: Poll 0xE6004100 until 0x12345678
Step 24: Call finish(0)
Pass_Criteria: Cache programming verified; Memory write data matches read data for all addresses

PCIe Register Write/Read Test - Validates reset default values and read/write functionality of PCIe controller registers (DBI), SII registers, and PHY registers. Tests multiple data patterns (0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555, 0x00000000, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xFFFF0000) with write mask verification.
Test_Steps:
Step 1: Call chk_rst_val() to verify reset defaults
Step 2: Read rc0_ctl_addr[0..4] and compare against ctl_default[0..4] (all 0x0)
Step 3: Read rc1_ctl_addr[0..4] and compare against ctl_default[0..4]
Step 4: Read sii0_addr[0..2] and compare against sii_default[0..2] (all 0x0)
Step 5: Read sii1_addr[0..2] and compare against sii_default[0..2]
Step 6: Write 0x01203000 to PHY_RST_CONTROL for PCIE0 and PCIE1
Step 7: Read phy0_addr[0..2] and compare against phy0_default (all 0x0)
Step 8: Read phy1_addr[0..2] and compare against phy1_default (all 0x0)
Step 9: Call chk_rd_wr() for read/write verification
Step 10: For each pattern in {0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555}:
Step 10a: Write pattern to all rc0_ctl_addr and rc1_ctl_addr registers
Step 10b: Write (pattern & write_mask) to all sii0_addr and sii1_addr registers
Step 10c: Write PHY_RST_CONTROL, then write phy patterns to phy0/phy1 addresses
Step 10d: Read back all registers and verify against written values
Step 11: Call finish(err2 || err1)
Pass_Criteria: Reset value = 0x0; Read-back matches written pattern
